description: Permanently deletes one persisted private diary entry belonging to the connected account after explicit user confirmation. Use the persisted ID from get_meals, recent_foods or log_meal; never a catalog ID or guessed ID. Confirm the exact entry before deletion. Retries of the same ID are safe: deleted:false means no matching entry remains in this account, not proof that a prior request deleted it. Each valid attempt, including retries and missing entries, consumes one shared diary call. Does not change the public catalog.

confirmed.description: User explicitly confirmed deletion of this exact diary entry.

mealId.description: Persisted private diary entry ID, not a catalog ID.

name: delete_meal
title: Delete a meal from Enshape
